name: Obama
overview: Scripture reveals that leadership and authority, including the role of kings and princes, are ultimately under God's sovereign control, as He directs the hearts of rulers according to His will (Proverbs 8:15; 21:1). While human wisdom can be flawed and self-conceited (Proverbs 26:12), God remains our refuge and strength in times of trouble (Psalms 46:1). The Bible also acknowledges the temporal nature of earthly offices, urging that those in authority serve justly and that their tenure is subject to God's providence (Psalms 109:8). In this light, any discussion of leaders, including Obama, must recognize God's supreme authority over all governance.
